recognize_zh: 多格骨髓抹片中漿細胞明顯增加，核偏位並有核周淡染區，細胞質從深藍到粉紫都有，可見雙核與細胞質邊緣呈粉紅火焰狀的形態，背景錢串狀紅血球，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Many plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and perinuclear hof
Heterogeneous cytoplasm ranging from deep blue to pale pink-lilac with frayed edges (flame-like forms)
Binucleated and irregular plasma cells; a cell with a cytoplasmic bleb
Some larger plasma cells with more dispersed chromatin
describe_en: Composite bone marrow aspirate fields show a marked increase in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and perinuclear hof. There is cytologic heterogeneity, including binucleated forms, enlarged cells with more dispersed chromatin, and cells with pale pink-lilac or flame-like frayed cytoplasm. Rouleaux formation is evident in the background with occasional neutrophils. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature and polytypic, generally under 10%, without binucleation or marked size variation.
Contains a dominant component of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein.
Morphology may overlap, so separation depends on clonal plasma cells below 10% and absence of myeloma-defining events.
